name: Cona (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cona (a female figure on blue and yellow) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Cona, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cona arms — female figure on blue and yellow, crowned, within branches
